catalog/product-change-events.yaml.commitment: In this fictional experiment Catalog offers product-change messages for successfully committed product updates and deletions through its asynchronous outgoing-event mechanism.
conditions: The relevant product update or deletion commits for the tenant
The audience is the existing modeled shop projection consumers

evidence.supports: Architecture context, not an owner commitment
Outbox implementation, not guaranteed downstream delivery

catalog/product-change-events.yaml.evolution: Only the modeled Catalog owner can revise this fictional offer.
limitations: Transaction commit, outbox recording, publication and downstream processing are different stages
No delivery or latency guarantee is offered
New consumers or changed purposes need their own applicability and acceptance assessment
catalog/product-change-events.yaml.rationale: Change events allow independently maintained shop read projections without requiring synchronous Catalog reads.
catalog/product-change-events.yaml.title: Catalog product-change events

audience: Existing shop image-read and projection consumers

image/image-promotion-information.yaml.title: Image promotion information

evidence.supports: Registered event consumers, not runtime processing proof

product-query/catalog-change-acceptance..evolution: Only the modeled Product Query owner may revise this acceptance; PQ-READ-01 is versioned separately.

product-query/catalog-change-acceptance..title: Product Query Catalog-change acceptance

conditions: The client is separately provisioned and authorized for its tenant and purpose
The request addresses supported tenant products using the published API

evidence.supports: Read model design context, not owner confirmation
Published API context, not proof of provisioned access

product-query/product-reads.yaml.evolution: Only the modeled Product Query owner may revise this offer, independently of PQ-ACCEPT-01.
